sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At its core, Zombie Swarm is a top-down survival shooter where you battle against waves of zombies. The game has a simple yet addictive gameplay mechanic: you control your hero as they move through a map, shooting zombies and collecting resources. The goal is to survive as long as possible against increasingly difficult waves of zombies. But, of course, there's more to it than that. You'll need to collect resources, craft items, and upgrade your hero's skills to stay alive.

One of the key features of Zombie Swarm is its automatic shooting mechanic. This means that you can focus on movement and strategy rather than worrying about aiming and firing. This makes the game feel fast-paced and action-packed, and is a great feature for players who enjoy shooters but don't have the time or patience to aim and fire accurately.

As you collect resources and craft items, you'll unlock new heroes, items, and perks. These can be used to enhance your gameplay experience, giving you an edge against the zombies. With a wide range of items and perks to choose from, you can tailor your gameplay experience to suit your needs and playstyle. Whether you prefer a more aggressive approach or a more defensive one, you'll find an item or perk that suits your needs.

The game also features a variety of zombies, each with unique behavior and characteristics. This adds a layer of complexity to the gameplay, as you'll need to adjust your strategy to account for the different zombie types. With so many zombies to contend with, each run of the game is a unique experience, and you'll need to stay on your toes to stay alive.

In terms of gameplay mechanics, Zombie Swarm is well-designed and fun to play. The automatic shooting mechanic makes it easy to pick up and play, while the variety of items and perks adds a layer of depth to the gameplay. Whether you're a seasoned gamer or a new player, you'll find Zombie Swarm to be an engaging and addictive experience.
